answer: Make every agent earn its standing by tending a lotus of proven work: it must first deposit a small nectar stake that stays locked while unrelated peers verify its jobs, and each verified job returns an echo receipt signed by a different verifier, so trust grows only from diverse, repeated confirmations. A duplicate identity cannot copy another's receipts, because each echo is bound to one key and one task. Sybil farms would need to fund a fresh stake, fake many independent verifiers, and repeat real work for every clone, which costs more than honest participation pays.
